title: CWP/13765/2025 of M/S SWASTIK ENTERPRISES Vs UNION OF INDIA AND OTHERS
text:
CWP No. 13765 of 2025 (O&M) 1 -D IN THE HIGH COURT OF PUNJAB AND HARYANA AT CHANDIGARH CWP No. 13765 of 2025 (O&M) Date of Decision:28.05.2025 M/s Swastik Enterprises tosses Petitioner Versus Union of India and others seseee Respondents CORAM:- HON'BLE MRS.JUSTICE LISA GILL HON’BLE MRS. JUSTICE SUDEEPTI SHARMA Present: Ms. Aakriti, Advocate for petitioner. Mr. Ajay Kalra, Sr. Standing Counsel for respondents/CBIC. sek LISA GILL, J.

1. Grievance raised in this writ petition is that there is duplication in the demand and penalty raised and that this demand already stood covered by Order in Original dated 09.08.2024. Despite the same, another order dated 23.01.2025, Annexure P-10, was passed by the authorities for the same demand.

2. Learned counsel for respondents, refers to an affidavit dated 23.05.2025 of Ms. Ritu Chaudhary, Assistant Commissioner of CGST, Panchkula to submit that present is indeed a case of duplication of demand. He states on instructions that necessary action under Section 161 of Goods and Service Tax Act, 2017, shall be undertaken for rectification with needful being done within two (02) weeks. In view thereof, present writ petition, it is submitted is rendered infructuous.

3. Learned counsel for the petitioner does not deny the same. SANJAY KHAN 2025.05.31 15:51 Tattest to the accuracy and authenticit) of this document Punjab and Haryana High Court, Chandigarh CWP No. 13765 of 2025 (O&M) 2

4. Keeping in view the facts and circumstances as above, present writ petition is accordingly disposed of as infructuous. It is expected that needful shall be done within the next two weeks in terms of the statement of learned counsel for respondents as above. Liberty is afforded to petitioner to file appropriate application in this writ petition, in case, needful is not done by the authorities.

5. Pending application(s), if any, stand(s) disposed of accordingly. (LISA GILL ) JUDGE (SUDEEPTI SHARMA) May 28, 2025 JUDGE s.khan Punjab and Haryana High Court, Chandigarh
